headline: Humanoid robot IPOs too hot, Chinese regulators start to "hit the brakes"
summary: Chinese regulators have begun to curb the wave of humanoid robot companies rushing to list. They are also reviewing soaring valuations and whether government-supported projects reflect commercial demand.
why: Humanoid robotics is a new listing segment in China, and regulatory scrutiny of IPOs and valuations shapes capital raising and sentiment for the sector.
